cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Read the first line of this letter before I do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Only if your face stays reasonably ordinary.

beats.text: I'll sit beside you. We can take one line at a time.

mechanism: A turns a familiar reading lesson around, correcting the former pupil pace while borrowing that pupil composure to face a difficult letter.
confusable: Not teaching literacy for its own sake: A cannot begin the emotionally difficult text and asks B to regulate the pace without explaining distress.
comparison: External task handoff versus intimate shared reading.
seedUse: D97 letter/ordinary face/finger; S05 reading correction becomes concealed reliance.
